# WO-006: Protect printable-summary accuracy with regression tests
Status: open
Vendor: codex
Agent: test-quality
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via tools/vendor.sh)
Drafted by: Elena Vasquez (Codex lead); approved by Morgan Reyes 2026-11-07

## Goal
Hannah Cole: add focused tests for the existing printable summary's
counts, status wording, escaping, and limited personal information.
One or two sessions. Product behavior stays unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Use isolated fake profiles and deterministic dates; no real keychain,
  network, mail, or browser submissions.
- Cover all listing states, verifying that requested/waiting,
  confirmed/removed, and not-found results remain distinguishable.
- Verify reserved internal broker IDs are excluded from totals and rows.
- Cover empty results, singular/plural counts, stable site ordering,
  and repeated rendering of the same inputs.
- Put distinctive fake address, phone, email, and birth-date values in
  a profile; verify none appears in the summary. The intended profile
  label and site names may appear.
- Verify hostile profile labels and broker names render as text.
- Verify print control and table heading semantics in generated HTML;
  document a manual print-preview check without claiming PDF support.
- Run the new tests plus existing wizard v0.3 summary coverage.
  Changed Python files are typed and ruff-clean.
- For a discovered product bug, add a narrowly scoped
  xfail(strict=True) with a clear reason and report the defect in
  Questions. Do not weaken assertions or fix product code.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- tests/test_wizard_summary_regressions.py (new)
- docs/vendor/WO-006-test-notes.md (new)
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
Product code, existing tests/fixtures, consent/security tests, exposure
engine/tests, registry/research, sending, CI/release, and WO-002 paths.
Do not change global fixtures or introduce dependencies.

## Check-in plan
After session one: provide the coverage matrix and any discovered bugs.
At completion: report passed, failed, and expected-failure results,
plus reproducible manual print-preview steps.
